issues.display_title: Issue #1293: fix: disable Street View account auto-deletion on token expiry
issues.main_description_html:
Feedback

Problem

Connected Google Street View accounts are being automatically deleted from users' GoThru accounts when the token expires or is revoked. This causes users to lose their Street View connection without intending to disconnect it.

Expected Solution

Remove the token recheck worker and its cron dispatcher entirely so that:

  • No background process rechecks or deletes Street View tokens automatically
  • No notification emails are sent to users due to token expiry
  • Users' connected Street View accounts remain intact until they manually disconnect

Acceptance Criteria

  • The recheck_token_google.php worker is removed from the codebase.
  • The recheckTokenGoogle cron endpoint (GET /cronjob/recheck-token-google) no longer dispatches any jobs.
  • The clearRecheckTokenGoogle cron endpoint (GET /cronjob/clear-recheck-token-google) no longer clears any state.
  • No auth_publish records are auto-deleted due to token expiry or revocation.
  • No notification emails are sent to users as a result of token recheck activity.
  • Manual disconnect (DELETE /users/street-view-account) still works correctly.

Note from Developer

The issue with deleting the Street View account likely does not stem from apil.gothru.co, as there are no APIs running automatically or business logic that deletes accounts without the user’s knowledge.

As for the APIs /cronjob/recheck-token-google and /cronjob/clear-recheck-token-google, neither of them is currently in use anywhere.

Here is a list of active cron jobs on the apil.gothru.co server

Since the two APIs above are no longer in use, I deleted both of them
